spans.s:
m. (-रः)
A sort of pulse, (Dolichos catjang.)
E.
Apparently not a Sanscrit word, though occurring in regular compounds.

m. (-कः)
A scribe, a writer.
E.
see वोलक.

f. (-ट्टी)
A sort of mat or mattress^1 for sleeping on.
E.
वोर Dolichos catjang, and पट्टी coarse cloth; perhaps made of the straw.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-वः)
A kind of rice, perhaps that called Boro, which is cut in March or April.

m. (-नः)
A horse, described as of a white and red colour.
